_doc: Posts on the pilot stretch (lamps, signal masts, sign posts are not told apart from the air). candidates: the shadow reader (strokes_read.py), filtered to the corridor and off the roadway; base = the sun-ward end of the shadow. by_eye: posts the reader missed at the one junction read by eye (census_by_eye.json). Heights are NOT written: the sun's elevation at the flight is not known (see PILOT.md).
